text:
Noah Baker: Hey all 👋 I’m Noah, starting today as a Software Engineer on the API team. Quick setup + intros thread. I’m remote (PST) but planning to swing by SF next Friday. Can someone add me to the api-service and infra-config repos? Also debating whether to request a loaner M2 or start on my personal laptop. Two quick fun facts: I ran a half-marathon in Antarctica, I once met a president, I can play the accordion. Which is the lie?

Nora Kim: welcome Noah!! 🎉 I’ll add you to #eng-api. For laptop: if you’ll be compiling native deps or doing perf work, request the M2. Otherwise personal is fine short-term. I’ll ping repo owners about invites.

IT Support: Hi Noah — welcome! Please submit hardware + access at https://redwood.internal/it-requests. If you post your GitHub handle we can pre-stage invites and create a yubikey + VPN ticket.

Noah Baker: GitHub handle is noah-baker. Quick repro of the clone error I hit while testing creds:```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/api-service.git
Cloning into 'api-service'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```
Any quick fixes before IT processes the ticket?

Priya Rao: try `ssh -T git@github.com` — if it says permission denied, likely no SSH key or agent. On mac/linux run `eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`. If you don’t have a key: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "noah@redwood.ai"` then paste the pub key into GitHub. Happy to screenshare for 5 mins.

DevEx Bot: Note: Noah Baker added to #eng-api and #new-hires. Buddy assigned: Nora Kim. Onboarding checklist: hardware pending, repo access pending.

Onboarder Bot: Welcome Noah Baker! Please schedule a 30m intro with the API team.

Noah Baker: Thanks — I filed the IT request and pasted my ssh pubkey. I’ll take Priya up on the screenshare if the clone still fails. Also… Antarctica half-marathon was definitely the lie 😅 Can’t wait to meet folks in SF next week!
